div.div: مِهْبَابٌ (S, L, K) and ↓ مُهْتَبٌّ (S) and ↓ مُهَبَّبٌ , of the same measure as مُعَظَّمٌ, (L,) (tropical:) A he-goat that is much excited with lust: or that rattles much, and is much excited by desire of the female: or that rattles much when so excited: see 1. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
